from pathlib import Path;import json,sys; p=Path(sys.argv[1]);sys.path.insert(0,str(p));import observe_exception_scope_v2 as v; protocol=json.loads((p/"exception-scope-protocol-v2.json").read_text());rows=[v.flags((p/c["helper"]).read_text(),(p/c["job"]).read_text())[0]==c["expected"] for c in protocol["cases"]];print(json.dumps({"matched":sum(rows),"cases":len(rows)}));assert all(rows)

from pathlib import Path;import json,sys; p=Path(sys.argv[1]);root=p.parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"agent/tools"));import documentation_retrieval as h; protocol=json.loads((p/"helper-admission-protocol-v1.json").read_text());observations=[]
for c in protocol["tasks"]:
 raw=(p/"reacquired-public-sources"/c["task"]/c["path"]).read_bytes()
 try:
  unit=h.extract(raw.decode(),c["selector"],c["language"]);h.validate_unit(unit,raw,c["selector"],c["language"]);status="ADMITTED_LEXICAL_UNIT"
 except Exception as error: status="REFUSED"
 observations.append(status==c["expected"])
print(json.dumps({"matched":sum(observations),"cases":len(observations)}));assert all(observations)
